My main Channel: JennaSampsonEquus

My old channel used for raws. My name is Jenna Sampson. I am a 19 year-old girl from the US with the passion of working with horses. Unlike other Equestrian YouTubers you may see, I only trained myself to ride horses without any trainers (other than my dad) due to the lack of english trainers in my state. I graduated in 2019 and I'm currently going to college to be an Equine Vet (and hopefully an Equine Chiropractor too). If you enjoy my content, leave a like and subscribe to my channel.

My horses:

Misty's Thunder: 2005 14hh black Quarter Horse/Kentucky Natural Gaited Horse mare

Shesthetownbully: 2011 16.1hh bay off the track Thoroughbred mare by Hesabull out of Harpy

Pj: 2001 15hh white few spot Appaloosa gelding

Jimmeny (my newest project horse): 2015 15hh bay dun Mustang/Quarter Horse gelding (he's currently for sale)

Horses I used to own:

Smokey (RIP), Hope (RIP), Jazmine
